description: Kalshi's own index of the real-world OCCURRENCES its markets hang off — games, elections, hearings, launches — from `GET /milestones`. Each milestone carries a title, type (e.g. baseball_game, football_game, tennis_tournament_singles, election), category, start and end dates, source ids, and — the reason to use this — `primary_event_tickers` and `related_event_tickers`, which are Kalshi's OWN statement of which markets belong to the occurrence. That is the alternative to matching event titles by string, which is how you accidentally group two different games. Filter by category ("Sports", "Elections", ...), type, competition, related_event_ticker (reverse lookup: which milestone is this event part of?) or minimum_start_date; page with cursor. A milestone id is also the key for kalshi_game_stats.

competition.description: Competition filter, e.g. "NFL", "NBA" (Kalshi's own spelling; many milestones carry none).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: 1-200 (default 50). Kalshi requires this parameter; we always send it.

minimum_start_date.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only milestones starting at or after it. Kalshi's default page is dominated by historical milestones, so pass this to see current ones.

related_event_ticker.description: Reverse lookup — return milestones linked to this event ticker.

name: kalshi_milestones
